title: docs(openspec): plan #3462 Accept a test helper group in the plan check
summary: The spec delta modifies the requirement `A test-only other group names its test function` of `roadmap-stage` with a text of 543 characters. Every stage gate accepted the plan, and the implement run stopped at `openspec archive`: the strict validation of the merged spec refuses a requirement text over 500 characters.
notes: The plan is the folder of PR #4435 as merged. The case reads it back with the plan reader, so its summary is the title of the pull request.
The implement run (PR #4465) did both groups and stopped at the archive. A person shortened the text to 451 characters, and the archive then passed (#4524).

defects.problem: The text of the MODIFIED requirement has 543 characters. `openspec archive` merges it into the spec, and `openspec validate --all --strict` refuses a requirement text over 500 characters.
defects.evidence: The text of `A test-only other group names its test function` has 543 characters, and the archive of the implement run failed with "Requirement text is very long (>500 characters)".
defects.message: The text of the requirement A test-only other group names its test function has 543 characters
